subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept this public `MemoryRerankProvider` SDK API, `memoryRerankProviders` manifest gate, exclusive-slot behavior, and builtin-only v1 scope?
rationale: This PR would create a durable third-party plugin contract, and code review cannot safely decide that API shape without maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Approve after conflict-safe rebase
options.body: Accept the seam shape, require conflict resolution that preserves current-main abort behavior, and rerun the memory-core, plugin-contract, tsgo, and docs checks on the rebased head.

options.title: Revise the contract first
options.body: Ask for a different capability declaration, keyed provider registry, qmd parity, or narrower SDK surface before this becomes public API.

options.title: Park behind the RFC
options.body: Leave this PR open but unmerged until the linked design issue has an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Approve after conflict-safe rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the seam shape, require conflict resolution that preserves current-main abort behavior, and rerun the memory-core, plugin-contract, tsgo, and docs checks on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily plugin SDK/API surface direction, and history shows substantial ownership of the relevant memory and plugin boundary work.
